# Carnegie Corporation of New York

> > Carnegie Corporation of New York is a philanthropic foundation advancing democracy, education, international peace, and Andrew Carnegie's legacy through grantmaking and fellowship programs.

Founded by industrialist Andrew Carnegie in 1911, the Corporation continues his mission of promoting knowledge and understanding. Led by the late Vartan Gregorian and now Dame Louise Richardson, it supports initiatives ranging from the Andrew Carnegie Fellows Program to library revitalization, civic engagement, and the Great Immigrants recognition program.

## Key Topics

- Democracy and civic engagement
- Andrew Carnegie Fellows Program
- Philanthropy and grantmaking
- Immigration and Great Immigrants
- Vartan Gregorian legacy

- Carnegie Hero Fund Commission

- Carnegie family of organizations

## Andrew Carnegie Fellows & Research Programs

- [28 Scholars to Research Political Polarization with Support from Carnegie Corporation of New York](https://www.carnegie.org/news/articles/andrew-carnegie-fellows-2024): 2024 Andrew Carnegie Fellows receive $18M for polarization research
- [Warning Americans About Creeping Autocracy](https://www.carnegie.org/news/articles/warning-americans-about-creeping-autocracy): Andrew Carnegie Fellow Masha Gessen on autocracy and political trauma
- [Giving Back: The African Diaspora and Higher Education](https://www.carnegie.org/news/articles/giving-back-african-diaspora-and-higher-education): Carnegie African Diaspora Fellowship Program connects scholars with Africa

## Democracy & Civic Engagement Initiatives

- [Carnegie Returns to Its Roots with Millions in Grants to Public Libraries](https://www.carnegie.org/news/articles/carnegie-returns-to-its-roots-with-millions-in-grants-to-public-libraries): Carnegie Corporation grants millions to public libraries for civic engagement
- [Carnegie Corporation of New York Contributes $5 Million to National Initiative Focused on Revitalizing Local News](https://www.carnegie.org/news/articles/carnegie-corporation-new-york-support-national-coalition-revitalize-local-news): Carnegie commits $5M to Press Forward local news revitalization initiative
- [California Passes Landmark Automatic Registration Bill](https://www.carnegie.org/news/articles/california-passes-landmark-automatic-registration-bill): California adopts automatic voter registration through DMV
- [We Love Our Libraries — and Especially Our Librarians!](https://www.carnegie.org/news/articles/we-love-our-libraries-especially-our-librarians): Celebrating 2018 I Love My Librarian Award recipients with portraits

## Immigration & Great Immigrants Program

- [Nominate a Great Immigrant Great American](https://www.carnegie.org/giga-nomination-form): Nomination form for Great Immigrants Fourth of July awards program
- [Great Immigrant and Chef José Andrés on the American Dream](https://www.carnegie.org/news/articles/great-immigrants-video): Celebrity chef José Andrés shares his Great Immigrant journey story

## Leadership & Vartan Gregorian Legacy

- [Essays by Vartan Gregorian](https://www.carnegie.org/news/articles/vartan-gregorian-speeches): Collection of Vartan Gregorian essays on democracy and education
- [Vartan Gregorian Honored by Republic of Armenia](https://www.carnegie.org/news/articles/vartan-gregorian-honored-republic-armenia): President Gregorian receives Order of Honor from Republic of Armenia
- [Congratulations to General Lloyd Austin](https://www.carnegie.org/news/articles/congratulations-general-lloyd-austin): Trustee Lloyd Austin nominated as Secretary of Defense by Biden
